questions.cardText:
[History] Who was the first woman to fly solo across the Atlantic Ocean?
A. Amelia Earhart
B. Bessie Coleman
C. Harriet Quimby
Answer: A. Amelia Earhart’s solo transatlantic flight in 1932 made her the first woman to fly nonstop across the Atlantic Ocean, which she did in just under 15 hours.
questions.en: Who became the first woman to fly solo nonstop across the Atlantic Ocean, in 1932?
questions.de: Wer flog 1932 als erste Frau allein und nonstop über den Atlantik?

timeline.labelEn: Amelia Earhart takes off from Harbour Grace, Newfoundland, on the first solo nonstop transatlantic flight by a woman
timeline.labelDe: Amelia Earhart startet in Harbour Grace (Neufundland) zum ersten Nonstop-Alleinflug einer Frau über den Atlantik

questions.notes: The flight took 14 h 56 min (departed 20 May 1932, landed in Northern Ireland the next day).

questions.cardText:
[Medical Sciences] Which of the following is Vitamin C essential for?
A. Production of hormones
B. Blood clotting
C. Collagen synthesis
Answer: C. Scurvy, a disease caused by a deficiency of Vitamin C, was a historical problem for sailors on long voyages, leading to the British Navy adopting the practice of giving sailors limes, hence the nickname “limeys.”
questions.en: The body needs vitamin C to make which structural protein — without it, the protein is too unstable, which causes scurvy?
questions.de: Zur Bildung welches Strukturproteins benötigt der Körper Vitamin C – ohne es ist dieses Protein zu instabil, was Skorbut verursacht?

timeline.labelEn: Vitamin C is isolated for the first time

questions.notes: Vitamin C also takes part in making some hormones/neurotransmitters, so the card's option A is not strictly false; the open question asks the collagen fact. The Royal Navy first issued lemon juice and only later limes.
